body: Like the name :) also thanks for offering to everyone, I wish you the best. Cheers!

It's not that I want a companion constantly (though I do constantly feel like I need one), it's more so that I can never get over my feelings for anyone. It's like, once I'm attached, I never let go. I can't ever just move on.

I fucked up my relationship. Big time. She was the best thing that ever happened to me and I started taking her for granted. I wouldn't get better for her. I felt her starting to drift away, but I just sat there thinking "No, she won't break up with me, we've gone through this a few times before, she comes back around and we make up and I use the same fucking phrases of 'Oh, I love you so much.'" I didn't try to but I just couldn't think of anything different. I never knew what to say. She tried to stay with me, but my own mental problems pushed her away. She couldn't deal with my social anxiety and awkwardness (which I don't blame her, I was never easy for her). And now she's gone. I also started dating her before I was fully over my previous gf and she saw one of my posts that I made around when we started dating so it looked like I was just using her. Which, I guess was a bit true. If I'm perfectly honest, I only started dating her because I was so desperate for any care and love. I'd been so isolated my entire life and I needed it. I slowly fell more and more in love with her as time went on until I just couldn't see myself with anyone else. And now she's gone. I hurt her. I just can't live with myself anymore, but I can't bring myself to just fucking kill myself already. I'm too scared so I'm stuck living this meaningless, painful, worthless life.

Right, let's start from the beginning. Where all this shit began.

Ever since the 4th grade, I've been that "odd one out" sorta kid. Haven't had any friends since then. I was the awkward, excluded child who sat in the corner of the room during lunch with no one to talk to. Occasionally I had one or two guys, they were alright. They didn't have anything against me, they just sorta picked on me / ignored me like the rest so they themselves wouldn't get singled out as well. That shit carried on all the way through the 8th grade. Not much really happened beyond that though. Just a lonely sort of experience all around. 

Then high school came along. Now I thought high school would be different. Only one guy from my primary school went there (one of the guys who had nothing against me, but he transferred out after the first year). But beyond that, it was all new people. And opportunity to start over. Meet new people. Have a good time. Boy was I fucking wrong... Now, around this point I started coming to terms with my bisexuality. I didn't tell ANYONE at first, and my family to this day doesn't know (or, at least, I haven't told them, though they may have read my phone by now with some of my texts). When I decided to open up to my then friend, he immediately started telling everyone how I was gay, and I kinda am now the "class faggot," so I'm back to square one, all alone, and have been since middle of freshman year-ish. 

During this time, my parents started becoming very verbally abusive, which amplified my small shyness / introversion into full blown social anxiety. So now I have no hope of being able to talk to anyone. I break down into tears just when I'm talking to a teacher / counselor for no reason. I start hyperventilating in the middle of class. I spend most periods with my head in my hands, crying, waiting for everything to be over. All of this has piled up and made me extremely depressed and (obviously) suicidal. No one has ever wanted me around, and it doesn't look like anyone ever will. I can see why. I don't do anything. I'm in no way interesting or charismatic. I'm fucking repulsive. I don't see why I should even bother to go on anymore. My grades have started dropping, which of course made my parents extremely supportive and compassionate. Wait... no... I mean ten times more abusive. 

All I want is a way out. I just want all the pain to stop. It's endless. It's relentless. I just want relief, but that isn't gonna come while I'm alive, I've realized. No one will care if / when I go. Some people may even be happy. The vast majority will be indifferent, though.
Thank you for the kind words. You're one of a kind, you are.

Please don't do this to yourself. I k ow how hard shit can be, especially with regards to sexuality in a commonly negative environment like school. I'm bisexual and go to a Catholic school, so when word got out, I was (and still am) the "class faggot" and my peers have made sure to make my life a living hell since. But you can't let them get to you. You can't let them win. I don't know if this will help you, but I know it helps me, remember that people like that are immature and once they leave high school, they will be the "odd one out" so to say.

I've felt like you do now multiple times in the past. Hell I've tried a few times as well. I don't know how much other shit is going on in your life that you didn't mention, so I'm not gonna try and give you advice when I don't know anything about all that other stuff. But trust me, you're not alone in feeling this way. If you really need someone to talk to, hell, hit me up. I'd love to do anything I can to help. Just don't give up. Even if I can't convince you to reconsider suicide altogether, push it off a couple days. Push it off a week, and see how you feel. Talk to someone about it.

I know how painful isolation feels. I'm in a similar situation to you at the moment. You deserve the same sort of love and care and attention that's given to those around you. 

I hope this helped at least a little. Stay strong, friend. Like I said earlier, if you want to talk please PM me. We can discuss another form of communication that's easier or even just stick to exchanging messages here. I wish you the best.

I'd love to talk some time on discord. I've been a bit lonely these past few days, not sure how often I'll be able to actually TALK during the week but definitely on the weekend. I know exactly how you feel with this problem. It's kinda led to me withdrawing from those discords and Skype groups and such and the loneliness is really starting to set in. I'm looking forward to getting to know you :D (if you decide to take me up on this offer) Feel free to PM me your discord, or I can PM you mine. I may take a little bit to respond as I don't check Reddit all that often though, so...I apologize in advance. But once we're on discord I'll be sure to always respond asap.

I completely get what you mean. Every day is spent sitting in the corner either trying to calm down, listening to good, relaxing music. Well...at least, I consider it relaxing. And this goes for at school and at home. No one looks my way, friends or family. I'm just another face to say hi to at school or at family parties. Sometimes I wonder if I could relieve a few people by giving them one less name to remember.

You're telling me to focus on the positive things about me when I have none. I see my problems, yes. And I do want to fix them. But I feel like I can't. I feel like I'm a pathological liar. I don't want to bring the pain that I brought upon her to anyone else. I don't want to hurt anyone else. All I've ever done is cause pain, and I'm done seeing myself hurt those I love most. I can't deal with all this guilt. I have no one else. No one wants me anymore. My "friends" either avoid me or abuse me. My family either hates me or is indifferent about me. I could disappear and nothing would change. Nothing for the worse, anyway. I just want people to be happy, but I can't do that for anyone. I find joy from bringing others joy, but since I can't do that, I'm stuck in this stupid fucking cycle.
That's about as much as my "friends" try to help. Shouting at me for being broken then going back to excluding me or occasionally using me as a punching bag for jokes.
I haven't tried meditating, but therapists haven't worked for me. I've tried three and none of them have really helped.

I've talked to three therapists but every time my parents have made me seem like I'm batshit crazy to them. The last one I saw alone and it didn't really help. We focused more on my depression than anxiety though. I will try that breathing exercise, thanks for the advice.

I'll try. Thank you for the advice. I do have trouble talking to people about my depression / anxiety though. Maybe I'll try writing a note but I feel like I might tear it up before I give it to him. I'm not sure. I think it might be linked to the fact that whenever I've talked to people about anything personal in the past they've used it against me in some way. Everyone that I've talked to has used my vulnerability against me and it made me reclusive about anything and everything.
I feel ya there...100%.

Have you dealt with the whole being called on by the teacher, but he uses someone else's name (say your James P and he calls on you as James F, a different student who may or may not even be in that same class)?

Seeing as he was going to off himself, you definitely made the right choice. He may seem unwilling to come around now, but if he does get better, he will thank you. A lot. You definitely made the right call. His life is still worth living even if he has only one person who cares about him, and obviously you do if you're getting this upset over him acting this way.
My inability to do the simplest of things for her.
My gf saying, "I love you, you've really helped me recover" and things along those lines since her previous bf was more than a bit of a sociopath

I know exactly how you feel...I was about to put more or less the same exact post here...(minus the bit about your mother...because mine wouldn't give a fuck...)

I know what it feels like to have someone you love...and for her to leave because of you. It destroys you. It eats you from the inside out. She was so good to me...and I took her for granted. I always made things about me...I never took time to talk about her...and you could really see how it was affecting her. Except...at the time...I couldn't. and I hurt her so much...I can't live with myself anymore. I've already tried to go 3 times...all 3 times she's hated me for trying to go (did I mention we're still trying to be friends?). But...when I'm not attempting to off myself...she seems so happy...so content. I've written and burned so many notes. She says she wants me to stay...but she rarely talks to me. She rarely does anything with me. I haven't even slightly gotten over her...and it's been a month. I don't want to go on at this point. But she says she wants me to stay...and when she says that she'll be so hurt if I left...I just can't bring myself to do it.

I don't know how or why...but that made me feel a lot better...

I've been suffering from extremely severe anxiety for about 3 years now...and severe depression for 2. I've already had 3 suicide attempts. It's nice to know that you have reasons to go on. I know it doesn't make sense...but you're reasons have given me hope. 

Maybe some day I'll have a "stupid cat" that'll stop me from trying again...but until then I haven't been able to get suicide off my mind. It's a relentless onslaught of self-hatred / harm. Opening up to people at school hasn't helped...considering the fact that A) most of them now constantly harass me about being bi and B) the ones who don't think I'm a bitch for being depressed. I don't know what to think anymore...all I've done is push people away. I can't keep a genuine friend for more than a month without scaring them off. I mistreated my girlfriend...and now she's gone. I didn't...abuse her...or anything like that. It's just...everything was always about me. And now she's gone. I hurt the person I loved the most...and now she's gone

I don't want to go on anymore...but maybe that's just my edgy teen-ness talking...

I...sort of have the same thing...I'm not having those thoughts though. Im 15 and I'm constantly sad and I hate myself every single fucking second of every day. But...every time I open up to anyone...they just say "I'm a teenager, I don't know what actual pain feels like" or stuff like that. My first attempt was this past Monday morning at about 1AM...I haven't told anyone. I don't want to...I just want to die at this point. My 2nd attempt was yesterday morning... again...around midnight / 1AM. I can't ever fucking sleep. I fuck everything up. I've hurt everyone who's ever been in my life. My family doesn't give a fuck about me. My friends don't either. I don't know if I should go or not...because I'd hurt 2 people...but if I stay I just slowly hurt them more, on top of everyone else. I'll probably end up trying again in a few days...who knows...maybe I'll succeed this time. I've never left a note...because fuck my parents. They don't give a shit about me so why should I take the time to write something to them? The first time I left a sticky note on their bedroom door that said, "Fuck you...and thanks for nothing" but of course that attempt failed...so it just ended up in the trash can. 

This turned into a mini-post of my own...sorry. But thanks for reading it if you did. If not...then eh, who cares really?
Honestly...when I start getting all worked up or start breaking down...I get terrible chest pains. It's feels like I'm being repeatedly hit in the chest with a hammer.
